post.caption:
Rwanda delivers blood to remote clinics by drone because a road takes four hours and a flight takes fifteen minutes. The same airframe class maps farmland, inspects infrastructure, films, and searches for missing people. The same one with a different payload changes what a small force can do, and the cost collapse is the real shift: capability that needed an air force now needs a van. The technology is genuinely indifferent to purpose, which is exactly why the rules matter.
